ESTJ>INTJ.title: A planner who can map the road to faraway goals.
ESTJ>INTJ.body: Thinking things through logically and moving forward with a clear view ahead is your core, in both your temperament and your character. On top of that, you have both the power to jump into a group and get things moving, and the power to think deeply on your own. You have the care to check the facts in front of you and the imagination to picture a future that doesn't exist yet. You're someone who can write "next week's to-do list" and "the five-year plan" in the same notebook.
ESTJ>INTJ.say: "Okay, so that's who's doing what. …By the way, do you think this job will even exist in three years?"
ESTJ>INTJ.do: After handing everyone a role in the meeting, you're sketching a new system by yourself on the train home.
ESTJ>INTJ.worry: After leading in front of people, you need more alone time than you expect. Choosing between what's solid right now and the ideal further ahead can make decisions take a while.
ESTJ>INTJ.karai: You've got a ten-year plan, but still no idea what's for dinner tonight.

ESTJ>INTP.title: Someone with both solid follow-through and a mind that thinks things all the way through.
ESTJ>INTP.body: Making decisions with clear logic is your core, in both your temperament and your character. On top of that, you have the drive to lead everyone through the steps, and the urge to dig into "why does it work this way?" on your own. You understand why rules matter—and you also enjoy questioning them and rebuilding them. That's why you're a great fit for slowly making old ways of doing things better.
ESTJ>INTP.say: "Deadline's Friday. …Wait, actually—wouldn't it be faster to flip this whole process around?"
ESTJ>INTP.do: You follow the manual step by step, while filling its margins with notes on "a better way."
ESTJ>INTP.worry: The wish to reach a conclusion fast clashes with the feeling that you haven't thought it through yet, and it frustrates even you. Your days out with people and your days holed up alone feel so different that planning your schedule gets tricky.
ESTJ>INTP.karai: While you were redesigning the system, the deadline for the actual task passed.

ESTJ>ENTJ.title: Someone who moves today's reality and the big vision at the same time.
ESTJ>ENTJ.body: Getting energy from people, deciding with clear logic, and moving ahead with a view of what's coming is your core, in both your temperament and your character. Alongside that, you have the steadiness to value solid facts and past examples, and the spark to bet on new possibilities. When you're put in charge, you can fold a safe plan and a bold challenge into one proposal. You can switch between caution and daring depending on the moment.
ESTJ>ENTJ.say: "Here's how last year's numbers look. …So this year, let's be bold and change the whole approach."
ESTJ>ENTJ.do: For a neighborhood event, you perfect the usual schedule—then quietly slip in one brand-new idea.
ESTJ>ENTJ.worry: Torn between the comfort of doing what worked before and the urge to change things in a big way, you rerun the numbers again and again before deciding. Others seem slow to you, so you tend to take everything on yourself.
ESTJ>ENTJ.karai: You say "let's decide together," but the conclusion slide is already made.

ESTJ>ENTP.title: Someone who brings a breeze of fresh ideas to steady progress.
ESTJ>ENTP.body: Getting energy from people and deciding with clear logic is your core, in both your temperament and your character. On top of that, you can build plans on solid facts, and you're light enough on your feet to change direction with a sudden idea. In discussions, you toss out ideas that surprise everyone, then pin it all down to "So who's doing what, and by when?" Fun and reliability live side by side in the same conversation.
ESTJ>ENTP.say: "I love that idea! …So let's lock in the budget and deadline right now."
ESTJ>ENTP.do: You plan a trip down to the detail, then swap out half the stops after a tip you heard from a local.
ESTJ>ENTP.worry: The wish to stick with what you decided and the wish to try something new take turns, so your own plan keeps wavering. When people ask "So which is it?" you get a little stuck.
ESTJ>ENTP.karai: You've got three proposals going, and you've cheated on every one of them with the next idea.

ESTJ>INFJ.title: A dependable organizer who also sees deep into people's hearts.
ESTJ>INFJ.body: Setting a course and moving forward steadily is your core, in both your temperament and your character. Along with that, you have it all: the drive to lead and the depth to think quietly alone, an eye for facts and an eye for what's ahead, the power to decide with logic and the heart to read people's feelings. At work you look like the schedule person, but you're actually noticing who's pushing themselves too hard, and where.
ESTJ>INFJ.say: "We'll go with this schedule. …Also, has anyone seemed down lately?"
ESTJ>INFJ.do: While putting together a progress chart, you add a sticky note with a personal word for each team member.
ESTJ>INFJ.worry: You worry that an efficient decision might have hurt someone, and replay it many times afterward. The more you take on roles that keep you surrounded by people, the less time you have to reset on your own.
ESTJ>INFJ.karai: You can worry about everyone—but you're the very last to notice you're tired.

ESTJ>INFP.title: Someone who carries a quiet ideal all the way to something real.
ESTJ>INFP.body: You like thinking on your own and holding on to what your heart says is good. But you don't let those ideals stay dreams. Once you decide to act, you also have the drive to make a plan, set deadlines, and bring people in to make it real. It starts with kindness and ends with getting it done. Being both a dreamer and a doer—that's your strength.
ESTJ>INFP.say: "I really think this is going to be something great. …Okay, let's get this far by next Friday."
ESTJ>INFP.do: A hobby you started just because you loved it has somehow turned into a full-on project with a spreadsheet and deadlines.
ESTJ>INFP.worry: You want to honor your feelings, yet you catch yourself measuring yourself by efficiency and results. The more you love something, the harder you try to do it "properly"—and the more it wears you out.
ESTJ>INFP.karai: You were talking about your dream, and three minutes later it has owners and deadlines.

ESTJ>ENFJ.title: Someone who puts warm hopes into the plans that move people.
ESTJ>ENFJ.body: Getting energy from people and moving forward with a plan is your core, in both your temperament and your character. On top of that, you have both a straight-ahead way of judging by facts and logic, and a heart that cares about people's feelings and growth. Put in charge of a club or team, you plan the practice menu down to the detail—and you also have words ready to lift each person up. Even in your strictness, there's always faith in the other person.
ESTJ>ENFJ.say: "Today's drills go in this order. …I really believe you all can do it."
ESTJ>ENFJ.do: When coaching a junior, you hand them a step-by-step guide—along with a letter listing three things they're great at.
ESTJ>ENFJ.worry: The wish to say what's right clashes with the wish not to hurt anyone, so choosing your words takes time. The harder you try to live up to everyone's expectations, the fewer places you have to admit you're struggling.
ESTJ>ENFJ.karai: Even your words of encouragement are prepared right on schedule.

ESTJ>ENFP.title: Someone who can have fun freely, on a solid foundation.
ESTJ>ENFP.body: Getting more energized the more you're around people is your core, in both your temperament and your character. On top of that, you have it all: the steadiness to check the facts and the spark to find new possibilities, the power to decide with logic and the heart that values feelings, the knack for planning and the ease to enjoy the moment. At events you're at the center of the laughter—and before you know it, you're also directing the cleanup.
ESTJ>ENFP.say: "Let's all go, it'll be so much fun! …Oh, I'll send the meeting time and what to bring later."
ESTJ>ENFP.do: A hobby group you started on a whim somehow has proper rules and an attendance sheet.
ESTJ>ENFP.worry: Caught between jumping at fun things and wanting to keep your commitments, you feel a little tug of regret whichever you choose. After going with your mood, you sometimes blame yourself for not being more careful.
ESTJ>ENFP.karai: You say you want to live free—while making a schedule for your free time.

ESTJ>ISTJ.title: Someone who can run a solid process by leading people or by working alone.
ESTJ>ISTJ.body: Relying on facts, deciding with clear logic, and moving forward with a view ahead is your core, in both your temperament and your character. On top of that, you have both the power to stand in front and take charge, and the power to quietly finish things on your own. At work, you explain the steps to everyone—then finish your own part, accurately, before anyone else. Whether it's a busy room or a quiet one, your work is the same quality.
ESTJ>ISTJ.say: "That's the process. Any questions? …If not, I'll get started."
ESTJ>ISTJ.do: You assign moving-day jobs to the whole family, then pack up the bookshelf by yourself without asking anyone for help.
ESTJ>ISTJ.worry: You're glad to be trusted with bringing people together, but afterward you're wiped out and want to be alone. You sometimes worry whether people can keep up with how thorough you are.
ESTJ>ISTJ.karai: "It's faster if I just do it myself" has become your catchphrase.

ESTJ>ISFJ.title: Someone who quietly supports people with careful planning.
ESTJ>ISFJ.body: Valuing facts and experience and moving forward with a plan is your core, in both your temperament and your character. Layered on top, you have the power to get things moving in front of people and the power to tidy things up carefully alone, a straightforward way of judging by logic and a gentle way of standing by people's feelings. At family events, you're the one who sets the schedule—and also the one who remembers Grandma's favorite dish.
ESTJ>ISFJ.say: "We're meeting at the station at ten. …Oh, and I saved Grandma the window seat."
ESTJ>ISFJ.do: Making the seating chart for a family gathering, you quietly make sure people who don't get along aren't side by side.
ESTJ>ISFJ.worry: Even when you should speak up, you think of the other person's feelings and swallow your words—then later think, "I should've said it." When people keep relying on you, your own rest keeps getting pushed back.
ESTJ>ISFJ.karai: You have notes on everyone's favorites, but go blank when someone asks for yours.

ESTJ>ESTJ.title: Someone who has grown, straight and true, the power to decide, drive, and deliver.
ESTJ>ESTJ.body: Your temperament and character are the same, so your power to turn plans into reality is your steady core. You connect with people, check the facts, decide with clear logic, and move forward step by step. All of this comes so naturally that people rely on you without a second thought. Because your way of doing things is so clear, you get big results in places that suit you—and in places that don't, you get worn down without quite knowing why.
ESTJ>ESTJ.say: "Okay, let's decide. Who's doing what, and by when?"
ESTJ>ESTJ.do: For a family trip, you print an itinerary with times down to the minute and hand everyone a copy.
ESTJ>ESTJ.worry: When others move slowly, you end up taking everything on yourself. Sometimes you say what you think is right, it comes across as harsh, and you feel down.
ESTJ>ESTJ.karai: Even your day off has somehow turned into "today's tasks."

ESTJ>ESFJ.title: Someone whose brisk efficiency comes with real kindness.
ESTJ>ESFJ.body: Getting energy from people, valuing facts, and moving forward with a plan is your core, in both your temperament and your character. On top of that, you have both a straightforward way of deciding by logic and a heart that cares how everyone feels. Organizing a group dinner, you stick to the budget and time—and still arrange a little gift for whoever couldn't come. You're organized without ever seeming cold, and that's thanks to this kindness.
ESTJ>ESFJ.say: "It's $25 a person, two hours max. …So, did we already order the farewell flowers for Sam?"
ESTJ>ESFJ.do: After making a fair duty roster at work, you quietly swap shifts with someone who looks unwell.
ESTJ>ESFJ.worry: You want to make a fair, logical call, but when someone looks disappointed you can't settle on it. You pay so much attention to everyone that you only notice how tired you are once it's over.
ESTJ>ESFJ.karai: Strict about the rules—and the softest of all on anyone in trouble.

ESTJ>ISTP.title: Someone who can both plan the steps and fix things with their own hands.
ESTJ>ISTP.body: Relying on facts and deciding with clear logic is your core, in both your temperament and your character. On top of that, you have the power to lead a plan in front of people and the power to quietly work with your hands alone, the comfort of deciding ahead and the ease of handling things on the spot. When trouble hits, you're giving everyone directions—and somehow you've already got a tool in your hand. You solve problems with both your words and your hands.
ESTJ>ISTP.say: "Just follow the steps on this sheet. …Eh, if something breaks, we'll figure it out then."
ESTJ>ISTP.do: Putting furniture together, you read the instructions carefully—then switch to your own way halfway and finish faster.
ESTJ>ISTP.worry: You want a plan, but you also don't want to be tied down, so every time you add something to your calendar you hesitate a little. After leading a group, you go quiet and just want to tinker with something by yourself.
ESTJ>ISTP.karai: You do read the manual. You just never tell anyone you did.

ESTJ>ISFP.title: Someone with soft, personal tastes inside a well-organized life.
ESTJ>ISFP.body: Valuing the facts and the feel of things in front of you is your core, in both your temperament and your character. On top of that, you have the power to move among people and the power to savor time alone, to decide by logic and to choose by feeling, to make a plan and to go with your mood. You may be all business at work, but on your days off you take your time caring for favorite dishes and plants. That careful touch shows up in both.
ESTJ>ISFP.say: "I'll have that done by tomorrow morning. …Oh, this coffee cup is such a nice color."
ESTJ>ISFP.do: In your balcony garden, you keep a watering log—while puzzling forever over which flower colors go together.
ESTJ>ISFP.worry: Switching between quick, decisive moments and slow moments to just feel things, all in one day, tires you out. You tell yourself "I need to do this properly" even about things you love, and the fun fades a little.
ESTJ>ISFP.karai: Even during your relaxing time, you're counting exactly how many minutes you rested.

ESTJ>ESTP.title: Someone who can follow a set path and also win in the moment.
ESTJ>ESTP.body: Getting energy from people, looking at facts, and deciding with logic is your core, in both your temperament and your character. On top of that, you have both the power to plan far ahead and the quick reflexes to change your moves as things unfold. In sports, you'd work out the game plan in detail beforehand, then read the other side during the game and pick the best play on the spot. It's because you prepared that you can make bold changes.
ESTJ>ESTP.say: "This is our game plan. …But if they switch it up, we'll adjust then."
ESTJ>ESTP.do: You make a shopping list for the barbecue, then spot a sale at the store and change the whole menu.
ESTJ>ESTP.worry: Between wanting things to go to plan and wanting to act the moment an idea hits, you end up breaking your own plans. When people say "Was there any point in planning?" it stings a little.
ESTJ>ESTP.karai: You're fast at making schedules—and even faster at rewriting them.

ESTJ>ESFP.title: A dependable rock who also knows how to make things fun.
ESTJ>ESFP.body: Getting energy from people and valuing what's real in front of you is your core, in both your temperament and your character. On top of that, you have both the power to decide by logic and stick to the plan, and the brightness to read the room and make it fun. At a family birthday party, you run every bit of the prep—and on the day, you're the one singing the loudest. Your seriousness and your cheer both come alive in the same place.
ESTJ>ESFP.say: "Decorations done by three! …Hey, want to try making something out of these balloons?"
ESTJ>ESFP.do: After neatly splitting up the cleaning jobs, you put on music and get everyone dancing while you tidy up.
ESTJ>ESFP.worry: The more you try to meet your responsibilities, the less room you have to be one of the people having fun. Choosing between making everyone happy and keeping things on track means the more fun the event, the more on edge you are.
ESTJ>ESFP.karai: You play both hype person and MC, then totally burn out on the way home.

ESFJ>INTJ.title: Someone who builds the road ahead with a caring heart and a forward-thinking mind.
ESFJ>INTJ.body: Setting a course and moving forward steadily is your core, in both your temperament and your character. Layered on top, you have the warmth to bring a group together and the power to think deeply alone, an eye that values the facts in front of you and an eye that pictures future possibilities, a heart that reads feelings and a mind that decides by logic. You may look cool at first, but every plan you make has a touch of "so no one gets left in a bind."
ESFJ>INTJ.say: "This is the most efficient way. …But I'll back you up until you get used to it."
ESFJ>INTJ.do: While mapping out your family's future plans in a spreadsheet, you also make sure everyone's birthdays are on it.
ESFJ>INTJ.worry: After you reach the logically right answer, you worry it might leave someone feeling lonely. Your days swing between wanting people and wanting to think alone, and you feel a little guilty every time you turn down an invite.
ESFJ>INTJ.karai: Right after a cool-headed analysis, you check your phone three times to see how they reacted.

ESFJ>INTP.title: Someone who uses answers worked out alone to help others.
ESFJ>INTP.body: You love quietly digging into ideas on your own, like an explorer of how things work. You also have a warmth that treasures the people around you and makes sure everyone feels at ease. That's why your thinking never ends in self-satisfaction—it always heads toward "Will this help someone?" Your sharp mind and your kindness are truly connected.
ESFJ>INTP.say: "Logically, it works out like this… as long as it doesn't cause anyone trouble, that is."
ESFJ>INTP.do: Hearing that nobody can sort out a schedule, you quietly work out the best combination and then casually share it.
ESFJ>INTP.worry: You need your time to think alone, yet you can't say no when people count on you. After giving the right answer, some nights you can't sleep, wondering if you hurt the other person.
ESFJ>INTP.karai: That thing you said you "don't care about"? You're the one who's cared about it the longest.

ESFJ>ENTJ.title: Someone who keeps the team close while pushing hard toward the goal.
ESFJ>ENTJ.body: Getting energy from people and moving forward with a plan is your core, in both your temperament and your character. On top of that, you have both the steadiness to value experience and facts and the vision to look far ahead, the heart to think of others' feelings and the power to decide by logic. Leading a team, you set big goals—and still remember everyone's birthday. You care about the numbers and the faces just as much.
ESFJ>ENTJ.say: "This quarter, we're growing sales to here. …Oh, but first, let's all go grab lunch."
ESFJ>ENTJ.do: While drafting the plan for a big project, you've already booked the place for the wrap party.
ESFJ>ENTJ.worry: You want to settle things quickly, but if someone looks unhappy you can't push it through, and later you wish you'd been clearer. Chasing both results and being liked wears you out.
ESFJ>ENTJ.karai: Tough on targets, yet you spend an hour picking out snacks for the team.

ESFJ>ENTP.title: Someone who keeps everyone entertained while firing off new ideas.
ESFJ>ENTP.body: Getting more energized the more you're around people is your core, in both your temperament and your character. On top of that, you have it all: the steadiness to value experience and the spark of new ideas, kindness that honors feelings and a mind that thinks in logic, the knack for planning and the ease of switching gears on the spot. In discussions, you put everyone at ease while casually offering an idea nobody else thought of.
ESFJ>ENTP.say: "Great work, everyone! …Hey, I've got kind of a weird idea—can I run it by you?"
ESFJ>ENTP.do: Organizing a class reunion, you stick to the usual program—and somehow add a quiz contest.
ESFJ>ENTP.worry: Torn between wanting to share your idea and not wanting to spoil the mood, you hesitate over when to speak up. Debates get so fun that after winning one, you lie awake worrying about the other person.
ESFJ>ENTP.karai: You start arguing for their sake, and halfway through you're just enjoying the debate.

ESFJ>INFJ.title: Someone who stays close to people's hearts and pictures their happiness down the road.
ESFJ>INFJ.body: Valuing people's feelings and moving forward with a plan is your core, in both your temperament and your character. On top of that, you have both the power to draw energy from being with people and the power to quietly settle your heart alone, an eye for the facts in front of you and an eye that pictures someone's future. When a friend comes to you for advice, you help in practical ways—while also thinking, "What would it take for this person to be smiling five years from now?"
ESFJ>INFJ.say: "For now, let's go together tomorrow. …I really think there's a place out there that suits you even better."
ESFJ>INFJ.do: Helping a friend with a job change, you gather job listings for them—and hand them a handwritten note of encouragement too.
ESFJ>INFJ.worry: Because you want so much to help, you carry other people's worries as if they were your own. You love lively gatherings, yet you're puzzled by how suddenly you want to be alone once they end.
ESFJ>INFJ.karai: You think so carefully about other people's futures, but your own next week is still blank.

ESFJ>INFP.title: Someone with gentle thoughtfulness and a precious world all their own.
ESFJ>INFP.body: Deciding with people's feelings in mind is your core, in both your temperament and your character. Layered on top, you have the power to move within a group and the power to deepen your feelings alone, the steadiness of trusting experience and a sensitivity that lets your imagination grow, the knack for keeping things on track and the ease of going where your heart leads. You take good care of everyone, while holding close a precious dream you haven't shown anyone.
ESFJ>INFP.say: "I made lunch for everyone. …While we eat, there's something I'd love to talk to you about."
ESFJ>INFP.do: After carefully managing the family schedule, you write long entries in your journal alone at night.
ESFJ>INFP.worry: When what others expect of you drifts a little from what you care about, it hurts whichever you choose. After going along with others, your feelings can't catch up unless you get some time alone.
ESFJ>INFP.karai: You tell everyone "Do whatever you like," but can't say it to yourself.

ESFJ>ENFJ.title: Someone who carries the smiles around them far into the future.
ESFJ>ENFJ.body: Getting energy from people, deciding with feelings in mind, and moving forward with a plan is your core, in both your temperament and your character. On top of that, you have both the steadiness to value the facts and experience right in front of you, and the power to believe in and picture the potential of people and things. In community activities, you run the yearly events with care—while thinking, "What will it take for people to still gather in this town ten years from now?"
ESFJ>ENFJ.say: "Thanks for helping with the festival again this year! …Next year, I'd love to do something where the kids are the stars."
ESFJ>ENFJ.do: Taking on a role in the neighborhood kids' club, you organize last year's records while also writing a proposal for something new.
ESFJ>ENFJ.worry: You're so happy to do things for others that before you know it, you've taken on too many roles. Because you want so badly to meet everyone's expectations, you're hard on yourself when things don't go well.
ESFJ>ENFJ.karai: "Don't overdo it" is your catchphrase—yet you're the one overdoing it most.

ESFJ>ENFP.title: Someone who cherishes people and adds new fun to every day.
ESFJ>ENFP.body: Getting energy from people and deciding with feelings in mind is your core, in both your temperament and your character. Layered on top, you have the steadiness that comes from experience and excitement for new possibilities, the power to stick to a plan and the freedom to follow your whims. When friends get together, you've booked the usual spot—and on the way home you're already planting the next good time: "Want to try that place next time?"
ESFJ>ENFP.say: "I booked our usual place! …Oh, but did you know a new café opened by the station?"
ESFJ>ENFP.do: You keep up with every yearly tradition, and each time slip in one new game that surprises the family.
ESFJ>ENFP.worry: Ideas keep popping up, but you also care about your responsibilities, so both end up feeling half-done. Trying too hard to make everyone happy, you push back the things you were looking forward to.
ESFJ>ENFP.karai: Your planner is neatly written, but choosing the stickers for it takes the longest.

ESFJ>ISTJ.title: Someone with real thoughtfulness and a meticulous way of working.
ESFJ>ISTJ.body: Valuing facts and experience and moving forward with a plan is your core, in both your temperament and your character. On top of that, you have both the brightness that warms a group and the focus to work quietly on your own, a heart that values feelings and a mind that judges by logic. At work you're trusted for your accuracy—and you're also the first to notice someone who's struggling and check in on them.
ESFJ>ISTJ.say: "The documents are checked. …More importantly, you look pale—are you getting enough sleep?"
ESFJ>ISTJ.do: After filing your expenses exactly by the rules, you quietly leave a throat lozenge on a coworker's desk.
ESFJ>ISTJ.worry: When following the rules clashes with helping the person in front of you, you agonize over it alone for a long time. You value your relationships, yet without quiet time alone you can't shake off the tiredness.
ESFJ>ISTJ.karai: People call you strict about the rules, but you're actually the easiest to sway with feelings.

ESFJ>ISFJ.title: Someone who can support people both out loud and behind the scenes.
ESFJ>ISFJ.body: Relying on facts and experience, valuing people's feelings, and moving forward with a plan is your core, in both your temperament and your character. On top of that, you have both the power to light up when you're with people and the power to carefully set things in order alone. In front of everyone you keep things running with a smile, and behind the scenes you've handled all the little preparations without anyone noticing. You're a natural both in the spotlight and in a supporting role.
ESFJ>ISFJ.say: "Thanks so much for coming, everyone! …Oh, if anyone's cold, I've got blankets ready."
ESFJ>ISFJ.do: Cheerfully hosting a welcome party at work, you've already asked the new hire which foods they don't like and adjusted the menu.
ESFJ>ISFJ.worry: Doing things for others has become so normal that you're slow to notice when you're tired. You're not good at saying no, and favors quietly pile up.
ESFJ>ISFJ.karai: You remember every single "thank you"—but can't remember the last day you took off.

ESFJ>ESTJ.title: Someone who keeps things moving firmly while caring for everyone.
ESFJ>ESTJ.body: Getting energy from people, valuing facts, and moving forward with a plan is your core, in both your temperament and your character. On top of that, you have both a heart that values people's feelings and a straightforward way of deciding by logic. As a PTA officer, you'd end the meeting right on time—and afterward quietly check in with someone who didn't get a chance to speak. Your power to decide and your power to care always work side by side.
ESFJ>ESTJ.say: "Then we'll go with this plan. …You were about to say something earlier, weren't you? I'd love to hear it."
ESFJ>ESTJ.do: After dividing up the housework fairly, you take over for whoever's worn out—"just for today."
ESFJ>ESTJ.worry: After making the right call, you worry whether it hurt anyone. Depending on who you're talking to, you go back and forth between speaking frankly and speaking gently.
ESFJ>ESTJ.karai: Five minutes after a stern talk, you're running out to buy their favorite snack.

ESFJ>ESFJ.title: Someone who has grown their gift for caring about people, straight and true.
ESFJ>ESFJ.body: Your temperament and character are the same, so caring about the people around you is your steady core. You get energy from people, learn from experience, and act in a thoughtful, organized way while honoring how others feel. With that natural thoughtfulness, you've warmed up every place you've been and brought people together. Because your way of being is so clear, you shine where you're appreciated—and wear down more than most in cold places.
ESFJ>ESFJ.say: "Has everyone eaten? Let me know if you need more."
ESFJ>ESFJ.do: You have every friend's birthday on your calendar and never miss sending a message each year.
ESFJ>ESFJ.worry: Because you're so sensitive to how people react, even a slightly cold moment stays on your mind all day. Often, what tires you out isn't your own weakness—it's being somewhere your kindness doesn't come back to you.
ESFJ>ESFJ.karai: You remember everyone's favorite drink, and forget to order your own.

ESFJ>ISTP.title: Someone with the care to bring people together and the knack for quietly fixing things alone.
ESFJ>ISTP.body: Valuing the facts and experience in front of you is your core, in both your temperament and your character. On top of that, you have it all: the brightness that warms a group and the focus to work with your hands alone, a heart that stands by people and a mind that thinks in logic, the comfort of deciding ahead and the ease of handling things on the spot. When a friend is in trouble, before offering comforting words, you've already started fixing their broken bike.
ESFJ>ISTP.say: "You okay? …Here, let me see. I think if I adjust this bit, it'll work."
ESFJ>ISTP.do: You were chatting with everyone at a family gathering, and suddenly you're alone in the kitchen fixing a leaky faucet.
ESFJ>ISTP.worry: Wanting to be close to people and wanting to do your own thing take turns, so even you can't predict your mood swings. Putting feelings into words feels awkward, so you worry whether what you showed through actions came across.
ESFJ>ISTP.karai: When someone says "thank you," you get shy and change the subject to tools.

ESFJ>ISFP.title: Someone with gentle thoughtfulness and a comfort zone all their own.
ESFJ>ISFP.body: Valuing what's real in front of you and deciding with people's feelings in mind is your core, in both your temperament and your character. On top of that, you have both the brightness to move among people and the calm to savor time alone, the knack for keeping things on track and the ease of moving with your mood. You're great at looking after everyone, and you also treasure time surrounded by your favorite scents and music more than anything.
ESFJ>ISFP.say: "Everything's ready, so don't worry. …Once it's over, I'm going to sneak off for a little tea by myself."
ESFJ>ISFP.do: When you invite friends over, you plan the menu well in advance—but pick the table flowers on the day, by mood.
ESFJ>ISFP.worry: Going along with others, there are moments when you lose track of what you even like. You want to plan things properly, but if you're not in the mood that day you can't get moving, and you blame yourself.
ESFJ>ISFP.karai: Your plans for others are packed; your plans for yourself are "if I feel like it."

ESFJ>ESTP.title: Someone who cares about everyone and moves fast when it really counts.
ESFJ>ESTP.body: Getting energy from people and valuing the facts in front of you is your core, in both your temperament and your character. Layered on top, you have a heart that values people's feelings and a no-nonsense way of deciding by logic, the power to make plans and the quick reflexes to read the flow and act. When trouble hits on a trip, you calm everyone down and find another way to get there right away.
ESFJ>ESTP.say: "Everyone okay? …Right, if the trains are stopped, let's call two cabs. Now."
ESFJ>ESTP.do: You'd been preparing an event step by step, then saw the rain on the day and switched to an indoor venue right away.
ESFJ>ESTP.worry: Wanting to act out of kindness clashes with wanting to decide quickly and efficiently, so you're careful your words don't come out harsh. You go back and forth between keeping the plan or changing it on the spot, and it lingers a bit even after you decide.
ESFJ>ESTP.karai: While worrying about everyone, you're secretly itching to move on to the next thing.

ESFJ>ESFP.title: Someone who cares for everyone and enjoys the moment to the fullest.
ESFJ>ESFP.body: Getting energy from people, valuing what's real in front of you, and deciding with your heart is your core, in both your temperament and your character. On top of that, you have both the power to plan ahead and the lightness to go with the mood and have fun. When hanging out with friends, you've handled the bookings and messages—and on the day, you're the one suggesting a spontaneous detour and laughing the hardest.
ESFJ>ESFP.say: "I booked the restaurant for six! …But before that, want to stop by that crêpe place?"
ESFJ>ESFP.do: At your kid's sports day, you've got the lunch and picnic blanket perfectly ready—and you're also the loudest one cheering.
ESFJ>ESFP.worry: Torn between wanting to prepare properly and wanting to enjoy the moment, you feel a little unsettled whichever you pick. You put everyone else's fun first so much that only later do you realize you didn't get your own fill.
ESFJ>ESFP.karai: You're the organizer, yet you're having the most fun—and almost leave without settling the bill.
